annotations.text:
Real thumbnails and avatars from the 1,274-item library, not placeholders.

The blocker: nothing serves media today. 1,246 webp thumbs sit in data/media/ with no route to reach them, which is why the built grid is text-only. Needs GET /api/media/:id over the existing MediaSink — local dir now, R2 binding in the Worker.

Content type is per-source and cannot be one flat list: a Reddit save can be a comment, a GitHub star never is.

The menu offers only kinds actually present, with counts from the same group-by that feeds the source row — so an empty option is never shown.

Tag writes to the tags and item_tags tables, which exist in the schema and have never been written to.

Archive needs one new column, items.archived_at. Deliberately a flag and not a delete: a re-import would resurrect a deleted row on the next run.

The switch writes `enabled` on the source row /api/extension/config already serves, so the extension stops capturing that platform on its next run. Same kill switch, per source.

Off dims the card rather than hiding it — an absent source reads as broken.
